intro: Privateer Bloads in Booty Bay is looking to acquire bundles of valuable akiris reeds for an associate named Groy. The plants have to be taken from the naga, who were last spotted on the northern beach.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You looking fer work, friend? I might have some if you're up for a little challenge.
I got a friend named Groy who makes a killing selling what the naga call akiris reed: it's some kind of valuable ocean reed. Not too sure what it's for, but he pays well for bundles of the stuff.
Ya bring me ten stalks of the stuff, and we'll have business to do. The naga were last seen along the beach to the north of here.

clips.title: Progress
paras: If ya got no business with me, then move along, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend. 10 stalks of akiris reed wasn't too much a challenge after all, huh? No offense to the naga, but hey, everybody's gotta make a living.
